title: Apollo Brown -Dalai Lama Slang feat Willie The Kid & Planet Asia
htmlContent:
Apollo oversaw this project every bit if he was directing a movie. The vision and concept were ironed out and the soundscape was set and sequenced. Once completed, he knew only 3-4 rappers in the world could give him the sound he desired. Enter Planet Asia who perfectly fits the function.
